hook.narration: This new fighter has no cockpit. And it already fired a missile.

scenes.narration: It's the FQ-44 Fury, one of America's new uncrewed fighter aircraft.
Built to fly with crewed jets, it uses semi-autonomous mission software.
In July 2026, its prototype fired an AIM-120 at a digital target.
But it didn't choose to shoot. A human still authorized weapon release.
Both Fury and FQ-42 Vengeance entered production, with 500 combat-ready CCAs targeted by 2032.
The next fighter wingman may carry missiles, autonomy, and no cockpit at all.
